skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim the pauses, add background music, and export as MP4 — and get edited...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Free Maker Editing — free AI-powered video editing and export.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB for quick, automated edits.
- Easily trim pauses, add background music, and export high-quality MP4 clips in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports session-based workflows, cloud GPU rendering, and multiple export formats.
- Simple onboarding with anonymous free tokens (100 credits, 7 days validity) — no registration required.
